title: Fire, Heat, Flame, Light, Lamp, Glory, Sun & Spudlight — Energy and Visibility Grammar
status: physical distinctions + biblical symbolism + project comparison
purpose: Prevent activation, illumination, temperature, combustion, divine glory and source-light from collapsing into one vague 'fire/light' symbol.
master_rule: Distinguish physical process, carrier, perceptual effect and symbolic office before mapping. Heat can exist without visible flame; light can exist without fire; a lamp carries a source; glory is textual/theological language; Spudlight is project-native.

physical_classes.definition: Thermal energy transfer associated with temperature differences; not a substance or moral force.
Rapid exothermic oxidation process in ordinary terrestrial contexts, often producing heat, light and reaction products.
physical_classes.distinction: Fire is a process; heat and light are outputs/effects that can arise elsewhere.

physical_classes.definition: Luminous gaseous reaction region associated with many fires.
physical_classes.distinction: No visible flame is required for all combustion.

physical_classes.definition: Physical electromagnetic radiation; visible light occupies a wavelength band perceived by humans.
physical_classes.distinction: Physical light does not imply truth or divinity.

physical_classes.definition: Bounded source/device producing or holding illumination.
physical_classes.project_neighbor: Eye, word/path guidance, maintained local light

physical_classes.definition: Physical stellar source dominating terrestrial daylight and energy input.

fire: sanctification/purification imagery such as Isaiah's altar coal

glory.note: Biblical glory/kavod can carry weight/presence language and in some theophanic contexts is associated with brightness/light, smoke/cloud and overwhelming presence rather than simply being a synonym for photons.

new_jerusalem.note: Revelation 21–22 makes divine glory/God and Lamb central to final-city illumination rather than dependence on sun/moon. A 2026 New Testament Studies article argues φωστήρ in Rev 21:11 should be read as 'light source/luminary' and identifies God as the city's luminary.

project_operators.forge: Process architecture using pressure/heat/work; fire is optional mechanism, not identical with Forge.
project_operators.red_activation: Project color/activation symbolism; not a universal physical temperature claim.
project_operators.blue_memory: Project memory/preservation symbolism; not a literal cold-spectrum neural law.
project_operators.spudlight: Project-native source-light/illumination metaphor; may connect to Sun, Eye, Spirit and House but remains interpretive.
project_operators.eye: Perception/discernment interface that may receive light but is not the light itself.
project_operators.shadow: Occlusion/unintegrated information; not mere absence of photons.

productive_tensions: Fire can nourish, refine, illuminate, sanctify, destroy or judge.
Light can reveal but can also glare, overexpose or be misinterpreted.
Heat can enable transformation or damage structure.
Darkness can symbolize threat/ignorance in some texts but can also mark concealment, gestation, rest or overwhelming divine mystery in broader traditions.
failure_modes: using brightness as proof of truth
turning symbolic red/blue into unsupported physics
equating divine glory with literal electromagnetic radiation
assuming destructive heat is automatically purifying
